verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox or test environment isolated from production. The flex tier is a cheaper, slower service level recommended for non-production tasks, not an isolated environment. The Swagger try-it-out explorer sends requests to the live API, and dedicated private endpoints address data isolation rather than test-versus-production separation, so all of these are adjacent features only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
